title: Case facts absent
issue: No balance, account type, residency status, source-of-funds history or tax filings were supplied. Every method is priced generically.
handling: The reader must confirm the four facts listed on the dashboard before acting.

title: Acquisition-date FX basis unknown
issue: The IRC §988 gain depends on the CNY/USD rate on the day each CNY was acquired, which is not known. The model shows 2024-average, 2025-average and same-day scenarios instead of one number.
handling: Tax shown is illustrative, at an assumed 24% federal marginal rate.

title: U.S. receiving-bank fee blank
issue: No regulator publishes what your U.S. bank charges to receive an international wire; it varies by bank and account tier.
handling: Left blank and excluded from every total, never entered as zero.

title: Correspondent-bank deduction blank
issue: The BOC tariff says overseas bank charges are passed through at actual cost, so a deduction exists, but no amount is published.
handling: Add your bank's stated incoming fee before comparing routes.

title: Spread is a one-bank, one-minute snapshot
issue: The 0.210% spread is from one Bank of China board reading at 2026-11-10 07:32:39. Other banks and other minutes differ.
handling: Re-read the board on the day you transact.

title: Residency classification undetermined
issue: 境内个人 includes a foreigner who has resided in China continuously for one year. Whether the reader is 境内 or 境外个人 changes which convenience-amount rules apply.
handling: Ask the bank in writing.

title: Emigrant route may not be available
issue: It requires a cancelled hukou and a consular settlement certificate. A U.S. citizen who never had a mainland hukou cannot use it.
handling: Confirm eligibility before gathering documents.

title: PRC tax on property gain not computed
issue: The 20% rate is statutory, but the gain depends on cost basis and holding period, and main-home relief may apply. No number is shown.
handling: Fact-dependent; blank by design.

title: Dividend withholding reduced by treaty?
issue: PRC statutory dividend IIT is 20%. A tax treaty may reduce it, but the applicable rate for this taxpayer was not verified in this pass.
handling: Blank; confirm with a tax adviser before relying on a treaty rate.

title: Card-network spread unpublished
issue: The BOC announcement prices the bank's own ATM fee only. The network conversion rate is a second, unpublished cost.
handling: Published ATM percentages are floors.

title: Offshore CNH route unpriced
issue: No official source publishes a personal CNH retail spread or fee for this corridor. The route is described but not costed.
handling: Shown as blank, with the cost of each 1.00% of spread stated instead.

title: Licensed-intermediary route unpriced
issue: Provider eligibility, licence coverage, corridor price and documentation are not set by any regulator tariff.
handling: Obtain a written quote and compare with W1.

title: U.S. state tax not modelled
issue: Some states tax or exempt foreign-currency gain differently; this model shows federal ordinary-income tax only.
handling: Add your state's treatment.

title: No signed U.S.–China FATCA IGA located
issue: Prior sessions searched and found no signed Model 1/2 IGA for mainland China. Absence of an IGA does not mean absence of reporting.
handling: Flagged rather than asserted either way.

title: §988 loss treatment not stated in the quoted text
issue: The statute quoted exempts gain in a personal transaction up to USD 200. It does not state that a personal loss is deductible, and personal losses are generally not.
handling: Do not assume a loss offsets income; confirm with an adviser.

title: Travel and ATM-operator costs excluded
issue: Cash-carry and ATM routes need travel or an overseas ATM, whose cost is not published and depends on the reader.
handling: Excluded from totals; noted per row.

title: Watch-list consequence is a bank/SAFE determination
issue: The rule describes the consequence for borrowing a convenience amount; whether a particular pattern is 'splitting' is decided by the authorities, not by this model.
handling: Avoid any pattern that depends on another person's quota.

title: 2026 federal brackets not republished here
issue: The 24% marginal rate is an explicit assumption, not a published 2026 bracket.
handling: Replace with your effective marginal rate.

title: Corrected: emigrant staging was repealed in 2014
issue: Several earlier pages in this repository price the emigrant route with a two-year staged payout. Huifa [2014] No. 2 Art. 6 expressly cancelled that requirement, and Art. 6(1) removed the RMB 500,000 head-office filing.
handling: Earlier figures that assume staging are superseded by this page.

title: User-reported 'considerable taxes' unverified
issue: No Chinese tax bill, bank quote or tax receipt was provided. Official sources show no PRC tax on the act of converting personal savings.
handling: The largest real tax line is usually the U.S. §988 gain, not a Chinese charge.

title: Form 3520 penalty percentage not re-verified
issue: The IRS page confirms the USD 100,000 reporting threshold and that penalties arise under IRC 6039F(c), but the percentage was not re-fetched in this pass.
handling: Statement limited to the statute reference.

title: No PRC provision taxes the conversion — an absence, not a ruling
issue: The PRC Individual Income Tax Law taxes nine categories of income; none is 'converting your own savings'. That is a finding from the text, not an affirmative exemption certificate.
handling: Stated as 'no provision found'; a PRC adviser should confirm for your facts.

title: Basis may differ if the money was a gift or bequest
issue: If the CNY arrived as a gift or inheritance from a foreign person, the USD basis and the reporting (Form 3520 above USD 100,000) follow different rules from selling your own currency.
handling: Asked, not assumed; not modelled.

title: Source register mixes freshly fetched and carried-forward pages
issue: Twelve sources were fetched on 2026-11-10; ten are official URLs carried forward from prior sessions with recorded excerpts and were reachable when first logged.
handling: Status column distinguishes the two.
